enabled.description: Set to false to disable the ListenerSet.

namespaceOverride.description: Override the namespace the ListenerSet is deployed to.

parentRef.description: Reference to the Gateway this ListenerSet is attached to.

group.description: Group of the referenced Gateway. Defaults to 'gateway.networking.k8s.io'.

kind.description: Kind of the referenced Gateway. Defaults to 'Gateway'.

name.description: Name of the referenced Gateway. This field is required.

namespace.description: Namespace of the referenced Gateway. Defaults to the namespace the ListenerSet is deployed to.

listeners.description: Listeners associated with this ListenerSet. Each listener defines how the attached Gateway listens for connections.

name.description: Name of the Listener. This name must be unique within the ListenerSet.

hostname.description: Hostname specifies the virtual hostname to match for protocol types that define this concept. Helm templates are supported.

port.description: Port is the network port on which this listener listens.

protocol.description: Protocol specifies the network protocol this listener expects to receive.

tls.description: TLS is the TLS configuration for the Listener. Required when the protocol is 'HTTPS' or 'TLS'. Additional TLS configuration fields (e.g. options, frontendValidation) are passed through as-is.

mode.description: Mode defines the TLS behavior for the listener. 'Terminate' terminates TLS at the Gateway, 'Passthrough' forwards the TLS session to the backend.

certificateRefs.description: CertificateRefs contains a series of references to Kubernetes objects that contain TLS certificates and private keys.

group.description: Group is the group of the referenced object. Defaults to an empty string (core group).

kind.description: Kind is the kind of the referenced object. Defaults to 'Secret'.

name.description: Name is the name of the referenced object.

allowedRoutes.description: AllowedRoutes defines the types of routes that are allowed to attach to the Gateway listeners configured by this ListenerSet. Additional allowedRoutes fields are passed through as-is.

namespaces.description: Namespaces indicates from which namespaces Routes may attach to this listener.

from.description: From defines which namespaces Routes may originate from. Defaults to 'Same'.

selector.description: Selector is a label selector used to select namespaces when 'from' is set to 'Selector'.

kinds.description: Kinds specifies groups and kinds of Routes that are allowed to attach to this listener.

group.description: Group of the Route kind. Defaults to 'gateway.networking.k8s.io'.
